_comment: Copy to models.json and edit. models.json is gitignored: it is the only file
that knows your endpoints, model names and credentials.
Placeholders usable in harness cmd/env and model env:
'models[*].models' maps a model key to whatever name each harness uses for it,
so the same weights can be addressed differently by different agent CLIs.

harness-a._comment: An agent CLI that takes an absolute prompt and runs in $PWD.

harness-b._comment: An agent CLI that takes an explicit working directory.

judge._comment: Optional. Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Omit to score pass/fail only.

gpu_cooldown._comment: For single-GPU hosts that hot-swap local models. Needs nvidia-smi.
